textRuns.value: Synthetic data. Serantau Palm Trading Sdn. Bhd., its 40 counterparties, all contracts, curves and FX are fictitious and generated from a fixed seed (20260906) for demonstration. No real price series is used. FCPO contract specifications are VERIFIED against the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives product page; the futures expiry rule used here is a generator convention, not the Bursa rule.
